children: CenterPoint Energy, through its subsidiary Southern Indiana Gas and Electric Company (SIGECO), entered into a Bond Purchase Agreement with institutional investors for $260 million of privately placed first mortgage bonds. The financing includes $130 million of 5.99% bonds due 2031, $80 million of 6.15% bonds due 2033, and $50 million of 6.33% bonds due 2037. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including repaying short-term debt, refunding long-term debt, and funding capital expenditures.
